description: This Java class 'ConnectionPropertiesImpl' implements the 'ConnectionProperties' interface, encapsulating serial connection parameters such as baud rate, data bits, stop bits, parity, and timeouts. It provides getters for these properties, a constructor to initialize them, and a toString method for representation.

classes.name: ConnectionPropertiesImpl
classes.description: Implementation of connection properties for serial communication, providing getters and a string representation.
